services.purpose: Runs a private self-only telemetry pipeline and health API; real log sources and sinks require separate review.

configFiles.content:
api:
  enabled: true
  address: 0.0.0.0:8686
sources:
  vector_logs:
    type: internal_logs
sinks:
  console:
    type: console
    inputs:
      - vector_logs
    target: stdout
    encoding:
      codec: text

acceptance.description: GET /health on the exact loopback origin returns HTTP 200 and an ok:true body; this proves only Vector is initialized and serving.
After separately approved source and sink configuration, prove one authorized event traverses the intended route without sensitive-data leakage.
Restart the exact owned project and verify the reviewed topology and event route still work.
